title: Get Organizations By Filter
description: Rule-engine-based list endpoint — an alternative to the simple `filter.*` query params on the plain list endpoint, for building complex AND/OR filter conditions. This endpoint is served by a separate microservice from most of the API (not `master_service`), and its filter schema differs in two ways from other modules' generic-filter endpoints: each `filter_rules` entry also carries an explicit `field_type`, and the `operator` enum is wider (adds `GREATER_THAN_EQUAL_TO`, `LESS_THAN_EQUAL_TO`, `IN`).
